title: Goal Parser Interpretation
summary: Interpret a string command using a Goal Parser.
statement: Interpret a string command using a Goal Parser. The command includes 'G', '()', and '(al)', which are to be translated into 'G', 'o', and 'al' respectively, maintaining the original order.
constraints: Command is a valid concatenation of G, (), and (al).
Translate these tokens respectively to G, o, and al without changing order.
hints: The grammar has three fixed tokens with fixed translations.
Replace the two parenthesized tokens; G already represents itself.
Convert () to o, then (al) to al.
Valid input contains no other parentheses, so the two replacements consume every encoded token and preserve order.
editorial: Valid input contains no other parentheses, so the two replacements consume every encoded token and preserve order.

tests.explanation: Tokens G, (), and (al) translate to Goal.
Four empty-parenthesis tokens become four o characters before al.
